title: Cheesy Chicken Cheese Balls 🧀🔥 crispy snack from scratch #shorts

segments.moment_description: Returning to the courtyard to cook
Mixing the chicken and cheese ingredients
Rolling the seasoned chicken into balls
Deep-frying the chicken cheese balls golden
Eating the crispy cheese balls outdoors

description:
Chicken Cheese Balls 🧀🔥 — juicy spiced chicken wrapped around gooey melting cheese, crumb-coated and fried till golden and crunchy. That cheese pull is everything.

Would you dip these in ketchup or mayo? 👇 Tell me below!

🌿 Made with minced chicken, mozzarella, onion, green chilli and herbs, coated in crisp breadcrumbs — the ultimate party snack.

Did you know? The trick to a perfect cheese pull is freezing the cheese-stuffed balls before frying, so the coating crisps up before the cheese leaks out.
